name: threadvault-vscode
description: Local-first archive and search for AI coding conversations.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: ThreadVault can open the dashboard, but source/workspace open actions and local history access depend on trusted local paths.

scripts.package:vsix: npm run prepare:app && npm run verify && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@3.9.2 package
scripts.publish:vsce: npm run prepare:app && npm run verify:publish && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@3.9.2 publish

threadvault.port.description: Local HTTP port used by the ThreadVault service.

threadvault.host.description: Bind host for the local ThreadVault service. Use a host name or IP only, including ::1 for IPv6 localhost; set the port with threadvault.port.

threadvault.clientHost.description: Host name the extension uses to open and call ThreadVault. Use a host name or IP only, including ::1 for IPv6 localhost; set the port with threadvault.port.

threadvault.nodePath.description: Optional path to a Node.js 24+ executable. Leave empty to use node from PATH.

threadvault.dataDirectory.description: Optional custom directory for ThreadVault's SQLite database and generated files. Absolute paths and ~ paths are supported; relative paths resolve from the default storage parent. Leave empty to use the extension storage default.

threadvault.memoryDirectory.description: Optional custom directory for Markdown memory notes. Absolute paths and ~ paths are supported; relative paths resolve from the current data directory. Leave empty to use a memory folder inside the data directory.
